description: Connect to the people you care about on Instagram. Pin the people you love to your Start screen By pinning people to your start screen, you’ll be able to see their latest post at a glance. This also makes your start screen more unique. Features Live Tiles with user's latest post Search tagged photos or users See photos taken near you (credit: https://apps.hienob.ir/app?pfn=31530bogascorp.ExplorerforInstagramBeta_41m97bp7w711p)
